hedge: Evidence mapping, not a certification claim. Requirement IDs name where Matrix Scroll outputs can support an assessment; they do not assert 800-171 compliance.

mappings.title: Event logging
mappings.evidence_note: Signed machine-action and commit records document security-relevant events.

mappings.title: Audit record content
mappings.evidence_note: Provenance and payload fields supply who/what/when content for reviewers.

mappings.title: Audit record generation
mappings.evidence_note: CLI and MCP surfaces generate records at action time.

mappings.title: Response to audit logging process failures
mappings.evidence_note: Fail-closed verdicts (CONSISTENT / INCONSISTENT / INDETERMINATE) surface verify failures.

mappings.title: Audit record review, analysis, and reporting
mappings.evidence_note: Evidence packs and OCSF-shaped exports support offline review workflows.

mappings.title: Audit record reduction and report generation
mappings.evidence_note: Epoch checkpoints and pack indexes summarize ranges for report generation.

mappings.title: Time stamps
mappings.evidence_note: signed_at plus optional RFC 3161-shaped tokens bind time metadata.

mappings.title: Protection of audit information
mappings.evidence_note: Signatures and trusted-key windows protect integrity and acceptance of records.
